result:
I fixed all three webhook problems, but I haven't run the test suite.

1. **Switching an endpoint off now sticks.** The update in `src/server/repositories/webhook-repository.ts` only saved the on/off setting when the value was "on", so a switch-off was silently dropped. It now saves whichever value is sent, so switching off and back on both work. While an endpoint is off, new events aren't queued for it; that skip was already in place and works now that "off" is actually stored.
2. **Deliveries already queued for a switched-off endpoint are no longer sent.** In `src/server/jobs/webhook-delivery-job.ts`, the delivery run now marks them failed with "endpoint is disabled", the same way it already handled deleted endpoints. They count as failed, and endpoints that are still on deliver and count as before.
3. **Switched-off endpoints count toward the plan allowance again.** In `src/server/services/webhook-service.ts`, the check made when creating an endpoint now counts every endpoint in the workspace, not just the ones switched on. A workspace at its limit can no longer create another endpoint by switching one off first.
